action.objective: Complete broad depth-3 search over all legal White moves to identify safe candidates given Black king on f7 and queen on g8.
action.rationale: Phase=broad_search requires candidate_moves=[] to cover every root before any commitment. Black king is exposed on f7 with rook h7; several checks may exist (Qxf8+, Qg7+, etc.) but must be evaluated for safety and refutation. Using half the node budget (3000) at depth 3.
